## Purpose

Guide a user toward target coordinates using distance, bearing and an optional augmented-reality camera overlay.

## Capability IDs

- `gps_target_navigator`

## Requirements

- Location permission.
- Camera permission when AR mode is enabled.

## Supported XLSForm calls


**From `example_odk_gps_target_navigator.xlsx`:**

```text
com.example.researchos.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='gps_target_navigator',input_target_latitude=${target_latitude_input},input_target_longitude=${target_longitude_input},input_arrival_radius_m=${arrival_radius_input})
```


## Inputs observed in supplied examples

| Field | Label | XLSForm type |
|---|---|---|
| target_latitude_input | Target latitude | decimal |
| target_longitude_input | Target longitude | decimal |
| arrival_radius_input | Arrival radius (metres) | decimal |
